description: This Java source file defines a Spring service class 'ReActivateClientCommandHandler' that handles reactivation commands for client entities in the Fineract system. It implements command processing logic by invoking a client write platform service.

classes.name: ReActivateClientCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the reactivation of a client in the system, marked with command type annotations indicating it responds to 'REACTIVATE' actions on 'CLIENT' entities.

methods.name: ReActivateClientCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ClientWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the reactivation command by delegating to the client write platform service to reactivate the specified client.
